title: Red's Blåhaj Fork
description: A fork of Hibi's Blahaj for me and my friends
body:
# Blåhaj

A Minecraft mod that adds the IKEA BLÅHAJ Soft toy shark and a giant bread pillow as items.

When you craft or rename a plushie, it'll have your username attached to it.

This mod is required on both the server and the client.

Forked from [Hibi's Blahaj Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/blahaj)
